notes.name: Paul Kavanagh
notes.who: Yacht chef ( not currently on board a programme until next season)
notes.alt: Paul Kavanagh in short-sleeved chef whites, arms crossed, on a quay in front of a white superyacht
notes.moment: So many moments to choose but definitely the multi purpose chocolate espuma, the raspberry clouds and the meringue work...not to mention the liquid nitrogen yoghurt espuma lollipops, all incredible.
notes.note:
It was amazing to learn from Martin and meet like minded talented chefs, such a wealth of knowledge to share between us. 
Makes you think about your own food ideas in different ways also. This course was very special indeed.

Looking forward to the next possibilities on this Educated Travellers platform. 

I think sushi in Japan for sure. 

Top tier Thai cooking ( not the average tourist style basic Thai food course we see everywhere in thailand.) 

I also think for chefs, a course in basic content creation and digital awareness on how to create captivating food preparation and photography to increase your online portfolio and presentation.... With a.i changeing everything now I think employers will look for real footage/pics from aspiring chefs.
notes.line: This course was very special indeed.

notes.name: Jaimee Kivell
notes.moment: Learning from Martin has forever changed the way I view food, its history, and its future
notes.note: The entire experience was great and immersive from arrival. Everyone was there because they were truly interested in learning. Martin was an incredible teacher and I felt he really cared about us taking away something we could actually use whilst still making sure we understood the science behind it all, so we could then go on to make our own creations. It was well organised by Arrnaud, he was always so communicative throughout the whole process and also a genuine and friendly guy, everyone was made to feel welcome. It was a fantastic experience.
notes.line: Learning from Martin has forever changed the way I view food, its history, and its future
